summary: Alphabet Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) registering a multi-tranche senior unsecured note offering totaling approximately $576.5B aggregate principal, across seven series maturing from 2029 to 2066 with fixed coupons ranging 1.965% to 4.599%. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, structurally subordinated to subsidiary debt, not listed on any exchange, and issued in minimum denominations of $100M. Proceeds to Alphabet before expenses are ~$575.1B. Joint book-runners are BofA Securities, Mizuho, and Morgan Stanley. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
